title: O que é arquitetura contemporânea?
summary: A arquitetura contemporânea é a soma de estilos de construção atuais, sendo esses diferentes uns dos outros e únicos - comparado a tudo que já se viu antes.
body_text: A arquitetura contemporânea é facilmente reconhecida pelas suas estruturas não lineares e sem adornos. Diferentemente dos outros estilos da arquitetura, ela não está associada a um movimento ou há um conjunto de padrões. Esse estilo mistura e reinterpreta essas correntes anteriores, garantindo assim, o seu caráter plural. As escolhas do contemporâneo refletem nos valores e pontos de vista do século XXI. Mais que isso, propõe-se a romper com o passado e busca aperfeiçoar-se cada vez mais. Seu objetivo é ser inovador. Em outros movimentos e eras, os estilos ficavam restritos à Europa e aos Estados Unidos. Já a arquitetura contemporânea está espalhada em todo o mundo. É possível encontrá-la em países como China, Austrália, Canadá, França, entre outros. Acompanhe esse artigo para saber mais sobre a arquitetura contemporânea no Brasil à fora. Tenha doses de inspiração através dos seguintes tópicos: O que é arquitetura contemporânea? A história da arquitetura contemporânea Quais as características da arquitetura contemporânea? Diferença entre arquitetura moderna e contemporânea Arquitetura contemporânea brasileira e seus arquitetos Exemplos de projetos contemporâneos Aproveite a leitura! O que é arquitetura contemporânea ? Fonte: Isay Weinfeld A arquitetura contemporânea é um movimento em que os estilos modernos se fundem e utilizam diversos recursos. Atualmente, esse estilo é o atual de arquitetura e ele teve início a partir da década de 80 e 90 do século XX - logo após do Modernismo . O estilo arquitetônico contemporâneo preocupa-se não só em oferecer beleza nas edificações, mas também com questões como sustentabilidade, ofertar funcionalidade aliada a integração com a natureza. Também é valorizada a inclusão do racionalismo do movimento modernista somado ao conceito minimalista. O estilo contempla todos os tipos de usos. Atualmente, existem casas, museus, prédios públicos e privados contemporâneos. Alguns exemplos incluem a Casa Yucatan em São Paulo, Royal Ontario Museum em Toronto e Bosjes Chapel (capela Bosjes), na África do Sul. A história da arquitetura contemporânea Considera-se como início da arquitetura contemporânea , algum momento após a era da arquitetura moderna e o período pós-moderno. Então, é visto como contemporâneo tudo aquilo que foi construído do final do século XX até o momento atual. O estilo contemporâneo conseguiu alcançar todos os lugares do mundo, devido à forte cooperação internacional em seguida à Segunda Guerra Mundial. Os arquitetos passaram então a ter, cada vez mais, facilidade com métodos e acesso a materiais inovadores. Isso permitiu que a criatividade e as possibilidades fossem utilizadas sem limitações. Vivemos em uma era onde a nova geração de edifícios parecem desafiar a lógica, a gravidade e, frequentemente, ultrapassar os limites do visto como convencional. Tudo isso graças a projetos que usufruem de tecnologias avançadas para prever o futuro. Quais as características da arquitetura contemporânea ? Um ponto muito importante considerado como característica da arquitetura contemporânea é a sustentabilidade . Com os danos ambientais causados pela alta emissão de CO2 dos últimos anos, o atual estilo de arquitetura procura soluções cada vez mais ecologicamente conscientes. Exemplo disso é o uso de materiais naturais e reciclados, como também a integração de sistemas energeticamente eficientes. Fonte: Emotion School | Behance As plantas baixas livres são heranças do estilo moderno , e hoje, muito bem empregadas na arquitetura contemporânea . Esse conceito permite que os espaços interiores sejam espaçosos e conectados, a partir da ausência de paredes internas, os cômodos ganham maior flexibilidade e mais espaço. As casas contemporâneas, em sua maioria, possuem estética limpa para manter ambientes luxuosos. Para quebrar a monotonia, os arquitetos investem, por exemplo, em curvas nas fachadas. Além do mais, a arquitetura contemporânea utiliza-se de materiais de construção e de revestimentos não convencionais. A título de exemplo temos: concreto, tijolo aparente, metais, entre outros. As aberturas dessas edificações contemporâneas são grandes e múltiplas , com vistas panorâmicas. O que garante aumentar a iluminação, a conexão com a natureza e manter o ambiente arejado. O vidro, também, fica como responsável de proporcionar a mistura entre os limites internos e externos. Fonte: Pinterest Clarabóias, grandes esquadrias de vidro e telhados salientes são algumas das soluções para criar ambientes harmônicos e com efeitos cênicos. #Dica: leia o artigo sobre iluminação zenital e saiba como valorizar seu projeto com mais iluminação natural e menos consumo de energia, clique aqui para acessá-lo. Na arquitetura contemporânea , valoriza-se coberturas planas e que se sobressaiam em relação aos pavimentos. Isso porque, a intenção é que ela forneça sombra e estenda a arquitetura ao ambiente perimetral. Por fim, mas não menos importante, o design sustentável é uma premissa importante nesse estilo de arquitetura. A utilização de materiais e processos que diminuam os danos ao meio ambiente é essencial na contemporaneidade. Reflexo disso, é a vasta utilização de painéis solares, telhados com cores frias e o paisagismo sustentável. Diferença entre arquitetura moderna e contemporânea As edificações da arquitetura contemporânea busca a criação inovadora e mais avançada possível. Já o modernismo apoiou-se na simplicidade e na natureza. É comum que as pessoas confundam esses dois períodos e empreguem erroneamente. No estilo contemporâneo é incorporado todos os demais estilos, como também a liberdade para criar a partir de linhas e movimentos dentro da estrutura. O estilo acompanha as tendências do momento. Na arquitetura moderna , que ocorreu no período da primeira metade do século XX, se tinha intenção de abandonar tudo que era considerado tradicional. Os arquitetos da época também entendiam que a forma seguia a função. Ou seja, a prioridade de um espaço ou objeto é cumprir ao seu propósito. Hoje, algumas ideias desse movimento são consideradas utópicas. No entanto, serviram para reinventar os espaços e como as pessoas conviviam entre si e o ambiente construído. “São características da arquitetura moderna as obras de linhas simples, quase sempre retilíneas e a utilização de materiais como concreto, vidro e metal – em seu aspecto mais puro. Já a arquitetura contemporânea está relacionada a um estilo mais recente de manifestação. Ele se baseia na mistura de elementos, formas, tendências e técnicas da atualidade.” - Fonte: Viva Decora Ainda é possível notar algumas premissas da filosofia moderna na arquitetura contemporânea , embora o contexto que condicionou o modernismo , não tenha mais relação com os dias vivenciados atualmente. Entre algumas características do modernismo , estão: Utilização do vidro em semicírculo nas esquadrias Janelas de canto Pavimento superior em balanço Valorização da assimetria Utilização do branco nas superfícies Uso de brises e venezianas Paredes de vidro Planta baixa livre Arquitetura contemporânea brasileira e seus arquitetos A arquitetura contemporânea brasileira buscou trazer uma releitura do passado, assimilando estilos como o moderno e o pós-moderno. Apesar desse respeito ao passado, o estilo tinha ânsia pelo futuro, o que gerou um belo equilíbrio e resultou na denominação “arquitetura do caos controlado”. Em relação às características da arquitetura contemporânea brasileira, não existem grandes diferenças entre ele e as demais partes do mundo. Em geral, os profissionais desenvolviam edificações com grandes janelas ou clarabóias, na busca por luz natural . Além de focarem no reaproveitamento de materiais e a utilização de recursos que gere o menor impacto possível para o meio ambiente. Os arquitetos contemporâneos procuram, cada vez mais, atravessar os limites da tradição e inovar tanto em forma como em funcionalidade. No presente estilo, valoriza-se as construções com formas irregulares, fragmentadas ou de aparência alternada. Já na função, o contemporâneo busca conforto através do design orgânico. Em suma, a arquitetura contemporânea é marcada pela presença do minimalismo - movimento artístico, cultural e científico presente em diversos momentos do século XX que tinha como premissa a utilização de poucos elementos fundamentais como base de expressão. Um dos nomes mais célebres desse estilo brasileiro é Oscar Niemeyer, onde assinou diversos projetos cartão-postal do Brasil e também outros países afora, deixando um legado impressionante de arquitetura moderna e contemporânea em diversas paisagens. O arquiteto foi o primeiro a utilizar o concreto armado de forma estética em formas curvas e ousadas. As imagens a seguir, revelam as principais obras do arquiteto. MAM - Museu de Arte Contemporânea, Niterói/RJ (1996) Caminho Niemeyer, Niterói/RJ (2002) Outro arquiteto importante do cenário contemporâneo é o brasileiro Ruy Ohtake. Suas obras possuem uma linguagem própria, marcada por cores e curvas. Em uma das suas entrevistas, confessou que sua produção de caráter popular passada por frequentes críticas por outros profissionais da área: "A população gosta muito dos meus trabalhos, mas os arquitetos, não. No começo, eu ficava preocupado porque a inteligência da arquitetura levantava polêmica. Há um establishment aqui, e eu dei um passo à frente. Todo rompimento no que está instalado gera polêmica com quem está na vanguarda, mas a arte e a arquitetura avançam em saltos." - Fonte: Archdaily Hotel Unique, São Paulo/SP (2002) O arquiteto e cenógrafo Isay Weinfeld também faz parte da nova geração da arquitetura contemporânea . É possível perceber, em suas obras, a inspiração vinda do modernismo . Isay confessou sua inspiração em nomes como Le Corbusier, Frank Lloyd Wright, Lina Bo Bardi, entre outros nomes do modernismo . Já no contemporâneo o arquiteto tem apreço pelas obras de David Chipperfield, Sejima e Nishizawa, e Yoshio Taniguchi. Conheça suas obras a seguir e identifique os elementos adotados por Isay: boas proporções, linhas retas e detalhes nos acabamentos. Edifício Oito, São Paulo/SP (2002) | Foto: Fernando Guerra - FG + SG Hotel Fasano, Punta del Este | Foto: FG + SG Exemplos de projetos contemporâneos Léo Doctor Housing O escritório do arquiteto Francis Kéré projeta arquitetura contemporânea com enfoque em projetos sociais. Kéré explora novidades de construção considerando os recursos locais e métodos de design que envolvem o coletivo. Ganhador do prêmio Pritzker 2022 por seu excelente trabalho em comunidades. Léo Doctor Housing, Léo - Burkina Faso | Fonte: Archdaily A clínica é feita em sistema modular, com blocos de concreto locais e de terra estabilizados comprimidos (CEB). Esses materiais locais e a forma em que são estruturados - uma parede de dupla camada - deixam os ambientes mais frescos durante o dia, pois aumentam a massa térmica. O telhado inclinado, de parte da edificação, é capaz de direcionar a água da chuva para um reservatório, para posterior utilização em irrigação. Esses métodos demonstram total preocupação com os recursos naturais e o meio ambiente - um das principais características da arquitetura contemporânea . Casa Pirajá Casa Pirajá | Fonte: Estúdio BRA | Foto; Maíra Acayaba A casa Pirajá, assinada pelo estúdio BRA, é um outro exemplo de arquitetura contemporânea . Em busca de atender a nova família, a estrutura antiga passou a dar espaço para uma nova que oferecesse iluminação intensificada e que seu pé-direito fosse elevado - favorecendo a passagem de vento. A organização do pavimento térreo contemplou jardim, sala de estar, cozinha e área da churrasqueira sem a necessidade de divisórias para separar os ambientes. Casa Pirajá | Fonte: Estúdio BRA | Foto: Maíra Acayaba A inserção da jabuticabeira e espécies nativas da mata atlântica no paisagismo da casa oferece aos usuários uma experiência única com a natureza sem sair de casa e, ainda, melhora o conforto térmico dos moradores. Além do mais, a estrutura metálica de vigas, pilares e lajes foi desenvolvida pelos arquitetos para ficar aparente. A escada metade em concreto e metade metálica também se mostra como um elemento protagonista no projeto. Descubra mais sobre essa bela casa da arquitetura contemporânea brasileira, assistindo o vídeo a seguir: Gostou do assunto? title: Their Best Christmas Gift Ever: Pregnant with twoplus After 4 Years
body_text: For Candice, 31, and her husband, 33, both White British, starting a family was a long-discussed dream. After getting married and settling into their home, they decided to officially start trying in January 2020. However, complications from a past IUD insertion meant Candice needed surgery, further delaying their plans. Four long years, countless ovulation tests and the crushing weight of disappointment every month. The pressure to conceive was almost unbearable, and the emotional toll was devastating. Then, Candice stumbled upon a twoplus Applicator ad on Instagram. The idea of a less stressful approach just made sense to her. "I don't care how I get pregnant," Candice told her husband, "I just want us to have a baby." And after some research, they decided to give it a try. Candice fell pregnant after just one cycle of using the twoplus Applicator, bringing an end to four years of trying and marking the start of a new chapter in their lives. Now, the couple is cautiously excited, still processing the reality of their Christmas Eve BFP. Read on for the full story. Responses were edited minimally for clarity. The above is an AI-generated image modelled after our real users to ensure anonymity. Q: Hi, Candice! Tell us a bit about yourself! How old are you and your partner, and what are your ethnicities? What do you both work as? A: I’m 31, and my husband just turned 33. We’re both White British, and we also both work in tech. We actually met at work and worked together for 7 years before I decided to have a career change. Q: Why did you start trying for a baby? How long have you been trying to conceive (TTC)? A: We’d had a lot of conversations about having a child throughout our relationship. Initially, it was always, not yet not yet, but then at the start of 2020 we found ourselves married in our home and we agreed to start trying for a baby in January 2020. We knew that I would have to have surgery to remove my IUD as there had been complications with it following a car crash in 2016, and then well, 2020 was 2020 with the COVID pandemic worldwide. I managed to get my surgery in November 2020, and we'd been trying ever since. My last cycle was actually almost 4 years to the day! Q: What were some of the biggest challenges you faced while trying for a baby? A: What felt like constant testing for ovulation, and the pressure for "oh I am ovulating, but I've had a bad day", the self-hate every time I got distracted by life and realised we hadn't given ourselves a fighting chance at getting pregnant this month. Also, as a SA (sexual assault) survivor, sex to a schedule is just not happening. Q: Were you diagnosed with any medical conditions relating to fertility by a licensed healthcare professional, and what tests did you do? A: Originally, when my Dr had found out about the complications with my IUD, I was diagnosed with PCOS. We then went to a private specialist because we were convinced something wasn't right with one of us medically to be told “nope you're both completely fine, you don't have PCOS” - and then basically just “good luck with TTC”. It was quite disheartening. Q: How did you first find out about the twoplus Applicator? A: An Instagram advert! During my standard evening scroll I kept seeing the adverts and it just made sense. Q: What made you decide to try it? A: The logic of the Applicator just clicked for me - bypass the stress, give yourself a damn good chance, and as quite nerdy people my husband and I geeked out over the fact it kind of felt like a little science experiment. Q: What were your initial thoughts or feelings about using the Applicator? A: Initially I'll admit I did think I was going to struggle with the applicator, but it is so easy to work with and it is comfortable. Q: How did twoplus Applicators help you achieve your family planning goals? A: It made me feel more in control. It took away all of the stress of TTC. Q: Were there any challenges or difficulties you faced during the process? A: I mean given our luck of getting pregnant first time, I think the only challenge I've got is I purchased 5 cycles worth of kits! Q: Did you involve your partner in the purchase decision? How did he feel about using the Applicator to try for a baby? A: After 10 years together my husband knows that when I present him with a purchase I've already done a lot of research so it wasn't a hard sell at all. I think I basically said, "I don't care how I get pregnant I just want us to have a baby" - talk about being romantic! My husband was also of the opinion that if I was comfortable with using the applicator then he was more than willing for us to give this a go. After 4 years [of trying], and nothing medically wrong with you, you do get to a point of "what's the worst that could happen?" Q: How many cycles did you use the Applicator? A: Literally one! I ordered the kits and thought I would have to wait until January to use them. Then low and behold instead of getting my next period I started ovulating (the joys of irregular cycles). Q: How many times within each cycle did you use the Applicator? A: Because of the aforementioned surprise ovulation, we only used two applicators, the day of my LH peak and the day after. Q: Apart from using the twoplus Applicator, did you make any lifestyle changes to prepare your body for conceiving? A: I'd actually been slacking with my "prep" recently but you know the standard stuff, eat well, exercise, try to reduce stress. Q: What else have you tried in your conception journey before using twoplus? A: twoplus was actually the first outside help that we went for, besides some fertility tests that told us nothing. Q: Would you recommend twoplus Applicators to other couples who are trying for a child? Why or why not? A: Yes, absolutely. It's easy to use, it fits in with busy lives and TTC so well. Q: What would you say to someone considering the use of twoplus Applicator in their fertility journey? A: Give it a go - at best you become pregnant, at worst you've had a few chilled cycles of trying. Q: If you could go back to the beginning of your conception journey, what would you have done differently? A: Oddly, nothing. I think four years of trying has really helped my husband and I in terms of knowing we definitely, absolutely want this child - and also finding out you're pregnant on Christmas Eve was such a wonderful moment I wouldn't change it for anything. Q: Exciting times (and sleepless nights) are ahead for you and your partner! How does it feel? How are you guys preparing for the arrival of your little one? A: I'm still taking a test every week to see the positive result because it just doesn't feel real. We're making wishlists, trying out names with our surname, but also very much trying to stay calm. The joy of using twoplus is that you can test so soon after ovulating because you're looking for that ovulation so I found out I was pregnant at only 4 weeks which is quite early, so we're trying to stay calm and chilled and not rush anything because well we've got 35 weeks to go! Disclaimer: Results may vary based on individual health, lifestyle, and adherence to product usage. Work Toward Pregnancy Success With the Applicator It’s understandably frustrating when you’ve trying for more years but still haven’t gotten the positive news you’ve been hoping for. At-home insemination kits like the twoplus Applicator bring new options for folks like Candice and her husband when trying to conceive. If you resonate with Candice’s inspiring story, you might consider exploring the twoplus Applicator as a tool in your journey towards building your dream family.

title: Broadcast API
summary: Create, edit, and send broadcasts from the API.
body_text: When we first launched our no-code email editor, Broadcasts , we focused on building the best user experience. We introduced familiar modern editor patterns and have continued adding new components ( Section , Code Block , YouTube , and 𝕏 ) and details. Behind Broadcasts lies a quietly powerful system that can queue, throttle, and send millions of emails, gather and display engagement metrics, and more. Enabling developers Today, we're excited to expose the full broadcast experience to developers . Send HTML, plain text, or React (with the Node.js SDK) to any audience. Available in all languages As with all endpoints, the Broadcast API enjoys full SDK coverage . import { Resend } from 'resend' ; const resend = new Resend ( 're_xxxxxxxxx' ) ; await resend . broadcasts . create ( { audienceId : '78261eea-8f8b-4381-83c6-79fa7120f1cf' , from : 'Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>' , subject : 'hello world' , html : 'Hi {{{FIRST_NAME|there}}}, you can unsubscribe here: {{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}}' , } ) ; The Broadcast API offers 6 endpoints for creating, updating, and sending broadcasts. Review in the no-code editor All broadcasts created with the API can be reviewed in the no-code editor before sending. Building broadcast integrations Full API coverage means you can build integrations with your product or web apps: Enable your users to create and send broadcasts without leaving your product Generate broadcasts programmatically for internal use Trigger broadcasts based on events in your app You can build and send broadcasts with the API and let the Broadcast infrastructure handle the queue, throttle, and scheduling implementation. Audience management Just like the visual editor, the Broadcast API uses Audiences to manage your recipients. Audience endpoints let you control audiences and contacts programmatically. When creating broadcasts, you can include dynamic audience data to personalize the email content. {{{FIRST_NAME|fallback}}} {{{LAST_NAME|fallback}}} {{{EMAIL}}} {{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}} When you include the {{{RESEND_UNSUBSCRIBE_URL}}} placeholder in the call, Resend includes an unsubscribe link in the email to automatically handle unsubscribe requests. Limitations Broadcasts created with the API are distinct from those created in the visual editor. While you can view all Broadcasts using the API or the visual editor, you can only edit and send broadcasts from the location where they were created. Get started today We're excited to see what you'll create and send. Visit the Broadcasts API docs to get started.

title: Managing Life Together: The Best Calendar Apps for Couples in 2025 - Sunsama Blog
summary: An in-depth analysis of the best apps and calendar tools for busy, high-achieving couples.
body_text: Navigating life as a busy, high-achieving couple can sometimes feel like solving a complex puzzle—there's always another piece demanding your attention, whether it's a work commitment, a social gathering, or a cherished moment with your partner. Here's the good news: the right shared calendar app can help transform that puzzle from chaos into a harmonious picture. Let's dive into some of the top calendar apps designed to help couples streamline their daily chaos into planned simplicity in 2025. Why Shared Calendars Matter for Couples Effectively managing a shared calendar isn't just a strategy to avoid schedule conflicts; it's a pathway straight to strengthening relationships. A shared calendar is about ensuring both partners feel informed, valued, and connected. When you're both literally on the same page—whether it's coordinating work schedules, planning date nights, or keeping tabs on family gatherings—life becomes smoother, allowing you to truly be present and engaged with each other. Think of it as a bridge that connects each other's worlds, ensuring that nothing important slips through the cracks. This kind of tool is invaluable when balancing individual aspirations with shared goals, fostering a deeper understanding of each other's priorities and rhythms. Data from our 2024 State of Modern Work and Well-being Survey highlights the significance of integrating personal and professional lives: over 50% of respondents reported that family responsibilities impacted their ability to perform their jobs, with 15.4% noting a negative impact. This underscores the importance of utilizing tools like shared calendars to mitigate these challenges by fostering better communication and planning. Essential Features for Couples When considering the perfect calendar app for you, these are some key features to ensure seamless coordination: Collaborative Scheduling : Easily manage events and tasks together. Look for apps that allow both partners to add, edit, or delete events. Smart Reminders : Never let important dates sneak up on you. Personalized reminders can help you stay ahead, whether it's a loved one's birthday or a critical meeting. Seamless Syncing : Keep everything up-to-date, no matter your device. Apps that offer cross-platform syncing ensure you and your partner are always aligned, whether you're on your phone, tablet, or laptop. App Integration : Connect with tools you love, like Google Calendar and Sunsama. The ability to integrate with other apps can streamline your workflows. User-Friendly : An app that feels like a joy to use, not a chore. Intuitive design and easy navigation can significantly reduce stress. Top Shared Calendar Apps for 2025 1. Cozi Family Organizer What Makes It Special : Cozi excels at bringing simplicity to the bustling lives of couples. Whether it's juggling schedules, planning meals, or organizing grocery lists, Cozi wraps it all up in an easy-to-manage package. Key Features : Color-coded shared calendar for quick referencing. Built-in features for grocery lists and tasks to keep you organized. Syncs smoothly with Google Calendar for effortless updates. Connecting with Sunsama : While Cozi doesn't directly link to Sunsama, you can sync Cozi through Google Calendar, which then integrates beautifully with Sunsama thanks to Zapier . 2. Google Calendar Why It's a Favorite : Google Calendar remains a reliable staple, especially for those who are already comfortable in the Google ecosystem. It's straightforward, dependable, and helps keep your schedules synced. Key Features : Effortless event sharing and cross-device compatibility. Integrated planning with Gmail to simplify organization. Compatibility with Sunsama : Google Calendar integrates directly with Sunsama, providing a streamlined workflow for enhanced productivity and an easy way to share your calendar. 3. Cupla What Couples Appreciate : Cupla shines in connecting personal and shared schedules, focusing on planning those special together moments. Key Features : Merges multiple platform calendars for a comprehensive view. Tailored to enhance planning around date nights and trips. Features a couple chat to ensure you're always in sync. Using with Sunsama : Cupla connects indirectly with Sunsama through platforms like Google or Apple Calendar. If you’re looking for custom workflow options, head over to Zapier . ‍ Bonus: Sunsama Why It's Loved : For those who cherish productivity paired with precision, Sunsama is a true asset. It supports a holistic approach to managing tasks, events, and strategic planning. Key Features : AI-driven scheduling to ensure you're on top of everything. Organized daily routines to foster continuous improvement. A focus mode to help you work deeply without distractions. Sunsama syncs directly with Google Calendar and Microsoft Office Calendar, or integrates with thousands of apps via Zapier, making it an easy hub for all of your calendars. Choosing Your Ideal Calendar Picking the best app comes down to your unique couple dynamic: Tech-Savvy or Simplicity? Decide if you want feature-rich capabilities or straightforward ease. Compatibility : Ensure the app syncs well with your devices and needs. Check if it supports all the platforms you use. Cost and Value : While many apps are free, premium features could be worth exploring, depending on your situation. Consider trialing a couple of options to see which interface and feature set fits best with your lifestyle and preferences. Maximizing Your Shared Calendar To truly make the most of your shared calendar, here are some battle-tested tips: Weekly Check-ins : Set aside time each week to align your schedules. This ensures that both partners are aware of each other's plans and can adjust as needed. Prioritize Together Time : Intentionally schedule dates and downtime. It's easy for life to get busy; putting these important moments on your calendar makes sure they happen. Thoughtful Reminders : Set custom alerts for anniversaries, birthdays, and important appointments. These reminders help you celebrate milestones and stay in sync. Color-Code Clearly : Make it easy to see at a glance who’s doing what. Different colors for each partner or type of event can help you understand your calendar quickly and reduce overlaps. The Magic of Coordinated Planning When you effectively sync your schedules using shared calendars, you're not just managing tasks; you’re enhancing your partnership. Whether it's Cozi, Google Calendar, Cupla, or Sunsama, these apps can transform your routines, easing the stress of daily management and boosting the joy of shared experiences. Looking to elevate both your productivity and connection? Explore these fantastic shared calendaring options and consider a free trial with Sunsama . It's time to upgrade your planning experience and, in turn, your shared life together. Future Trends in Shared Calendar Apps As technology evolves, we can expect to see even more features in shared calendar apps that cater specifically to couples. Features like AI-based suggestions for scheduling and enhanced privacy controls can become more integral, allowing better personalization and security. It's an exciting time for productivity tools, and staying informed about the latest updates can help you choose a tool that not only meets but exceeds your expectations. Be on the lookout for features that mesh well with your lifestyle and help propel your partnership forward. By investing a little time in selecting the right app and setting it up thoughtfully, you can promote a positive balance between personal ambition and shared goals, strengthening both your bond and your productivity. ‍

title: Scaling Customer Support with AI: 5 Ways to Do It Right
summary: Scaling your customer support with AI deflates ticket load, enhances delivery even during peak hours, and boosts customer satisfaction. Here’s how to do it.
body_text: Your customers expect you to be there every step of the way, but that’s difficult to do as your business scales. More customers also mean more tickets—which increases your agent workload and decreases the efficiency of your support delivery. This results in longer response times, unsatisfied customers, and a declining ROI. To avoid such an outcome, you need to scale your support along with your growth. And that’s where AI comes in. Businesses using AI have reported a significant 30% drop in customer support volume and a 45% cut in customer service operations cost. Interestingly, 52% of consumers now want AI to help improve their experiences and 61% prefer faster responses from AI than waiting to talk to an agent. AI adoption to scale customer support is therefore a necessity if you want to maintain an edge over your competitors. In this article, we’ll explore a few ways to do that. 5 ways to scale customer support with AI Utilizing AI to scale your customer support enhances customer experience and satisfaction while reducing operational cost, agent workload, and burnout. To get started, here are some expert-recommended strategies you can try: 1. Implement AI-powered chatbots to resolve routine queries A typical payment system, say Payoneer, will likely face a barrage of routine queries such as transaction status updates, account verification issues, delayed payments, withdrawal failures, currency conversion rates, refund processing, and fee clarifications. Imagine assigning an agent to constantly retrieve transaction status updates for customers when they could be handling more complex technical issues instead. For a small business with only a couple of queries daily, that might not be any issue. But it’s a game changer for larger brands or those scaling rapidly. The consequences are far reaching: Routine and monotonous queries can cause agent burnout, which in turn, affects delivery. Customers with technical complaints receive diffused attention and eventually a poor experience. Unsatisfied customers are more likely to switch to competitors, reducing your customer retention rate and increasing acquisition costs. You can proactively avoid these issues by transferring your routines to Chatbots. These bots are capable of addressing repetitive requests by leveraging pre-trained data and access to your knowledge base. According to a recent report from Comm100, AI-chatbots can reduce routine queries by up to 80% , thus freeing up your agents to do other core tasks. Sephora is an example of a brand using chatbots to reduce the queue and provide excellent support. The beauty retailer integrated AI-driven chatbots into its social media platforms such as Facebook’s Messenger. ‍ It not only handles repetitive questions, but also provides product recommendations and helps customers try out their choice before making a purchase. Sephora also introduced smart bots on its website to handle common queries. According to Renascence, this implementation has helped it reduce response time by 40% and boost customer satisfaction even at peak hours. As an all-in-one, omnichannel customer service platform, Plivo CX offers an OpenAI-powered chatbot to help deliver exceptional customer support around the clock and take the load off your agents. ‍ Enhance customer support with AI-driven chatbots for faster query resolution. ‍ 2. Empower agents with generative AI for real-time assistance We get it—it’s quite unavoidable to get stuck choosing the appropriate words to respond with. And sometimes, peak hours won’t give your agents the luxury of time to decide on one. This is where GenAI is a perfect fit as a solution. GenAI primarily uses ML and NLP to analyze customer queries and data. The insights from this analysis are then used to provide real-time suggestions, context-aware responses, and automated knowledge retrieval during interactions. That means your agents can copy and paste an auto-generated response template tailored to the customer they’re helping. Besides harshing out templates, GenAI can also auto-complete your sentences, especially when the complaints are so common. This helps to improve response time, reduce the workload on your agents, and clear ticket logs faster, thus highlighting why 85% of customer service leaders hope to integrate the technology in 2025. 3. Use an AI-optimized knowledge base to reduce ticket load Empowering your agents is a good customer support strategy, but empowering your customers is even better. According to Gartner, approximately 73% of customers use self-service options such as knowledge bases and FAQs to find answers at some point in their customer journey. This effectively reduces the number of queries logged and helps your agents focus on issues customers can’t resolve by themselves. However, only 14% of customer support issues are fully resolved via self-service, leaving the remaining 86% to agents and chatbots. Additionally, 45% of customers who engage self-help feel companies don’t understand their problems. In 43% of failed self-service cases, the reason for failure is that customers can’t find relevant content to their queries. Not finding a useful solution frustrates your customers. Frustration weakens customer trust in your brand and damages your relationship. To avoid this, you can employ AI to create a rich knowledge base through automated tagging. AI-tagging systems analyze your common queries, especially those not likely to require specialized intervention, and high-volume complaints to reveal where your customers are struggling the most. AI-tagging categorizes high-yield issues to help you create relevant content for your knowledge base ‍ This allows you to create targeted content and populate your knowledge base with the right articles, ensuring your customers find the content they need at the right time. Your agents can also use this content as a reference when resolving unfamiliar complaints. ‍ Plivo CX’s Unified Agent Desktop solution helps you integrate AI-optimized custom knowledge base with your communication channels and enables easy data retrieval in real time. Retrieve the information you need from your custom knowledge base while interacting with a customer 4. Implement smart routing to direct tickets to the right agents Smart routing utilizes AI algorithms to automatically assign incoming support tickets to the most suitable agents based on various factors such as skills, availability, workload, and priority. This ensures tickets reach the right experts faster while streamlining escalations to prevent agents from being overwhelmed with issues beyond their expertise. When customers lose contact with an agent, advanced AI systems can also reconnect them rather than assigning a new agent when they reach out again. For example, Plivo CX’s IVR solution uses sticky routing to ensure repeat callers are directed to the same agent, enhancing the experience for both customers and agents. Smart routing ensures accurate matching with the right agent and reduces the incidence of ticket collision. Most importantly, AI-powered routing minimizes ticket collision, which occurs when two agents work on the same ticket unknowingly. 5. Meet customers where they are with scalable omnichannel support 35% of customers expect to be able to contact the same customer service representative on any channel. But this can be cumbersome since your agents have to switch from one channel’s tab to another as required. Needless to say, this is time-consuming and may lead to disconnected customer experiences if you fail to meet the expectation. Using AI-driven omnichannel support solutions resolves this impasse. Omnichannel platforms integrate all communication channels to give your agents a single point of view when addressing queries, eliminating tab switching. Plivo CX’s Unified Agent Desktop is designed to help you seamlessly switch between voice, chat, text/SMS, and WhatsApp or use multiple channels simultaneously. It also enables integration with your CRMs, ERPs, and other home-grown systems, utilizing customer data to deliver personalized experiences. Centralize your communications to avoid disconnect and provide consistent experience across channels Scaling customer support with Plivo CX You need the right AI-driven tools to scale your customer support effectively. Plivo CX offers an OpenAI-powered self-service Chatbot that you can customize to autonomously address routine customer queries or escalate when necessary. You can also embed this Chatbot into your app to provide in-app customer service and reduce agent workload. In addition to that, Plivo CX offers several features, such as: Unified communication : As noted before, you can manage all customer conversations across channels like email, voice , SMS , WhatsApp, and live chat from a single, agent-friendly platform Seamless integrations : Connect Plivo CX with your existing tools, including CRM, ERP, helpdesk, home-grown systems, and more Data-driven optimization : Track real-time analytics and generate custom reports to gain insights into customer interactions and agent performance Communication with media support : Enhance interactions with multimedia support, including images, videos, and documents Increased productivity : Streamline workflows with message templates, internal notes, and skills-based routing Comprehensive features : Leverage call recording, IVR , multi-language support, and robust security features for a complete solution To learn more, book a demo! ‍ ‍

body_text: Premium streaming entertainment now comes standard on all Foxx smartphones and tablets Irvine, CA, Feb. 10, 2025 — Foxx Development Holdings Inc. (“Foxx Development” or “Company”) (Nasdaq: FOXX), a leading provider of consumer electronics and integrated Internet-of-Things (IoT) solutions for retail and institutional clients, today announced that it has entered into a strategic distribution agreement with FreeCast Inc. so that FreeCast’s streaming platform will be available to users of the Company’s mobile device portfolio. The new integration will give Foxx Development’s users immediate access to FreeCast’s entertainment hub, consolidating hundreds of streaming services into a single user-friendly interface. Under the agreement, FreeCast’s all-in-one streaming platform will be installed on hundreds of thousands of smartphones and tablets of the Company to expand its out-of-box entertainment offerings. Users will gain immediate access to FreeCast’s entertainment hub, which features over 700 free channels, extensive on-demand content, and integration with major streaming services, including Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, HBO Max, and Hulu. FreeCast’s intelligent universal search feature enables users to easily discover content across all platforms, while its innovative YouBundle feature simplifies subscription management by consolidating multiple streaming services into a single monthly bill. “Modern content consumers face increasing complexity in their streaming entertainment choices, with recent industry surveys showing that approximately 65% of Americans struggle to discover content across multiple platforms,” said Greg Foley, CEO of Foxx Development Holdings. “Our partnership with FreeCast directly addresses these challenges by providing our users with an intelligent, cost-effective solution that simplifies content discovery and streaming subscription management.” “Partnering with Foxx Development represents a significant milestone in FreeCast’s mission to simplify the streaming experience,” added William Mobley, Founder and CEO of FreeCast. “By integrating our platform directly into Foxx Development’s devices, we’re making it easier than ever for users to discover, access, and manage their entertainment. This collaboration demonstrates how device manufacturers and content platforms can work together to solve the fragmentation challenges facing today’s streamers.” About Foxx Development Holdings Inc. Foxx Development is a consumer electronics and integrated Internet-of-Things (IoT) solution company catering to both retail and institutional clients. With robust research and development capabilities and a strategic commitment to cultivating long-term partnerships with mobile network operators, distributors and suppliers around the world, it currently sells a diverse range of products including mobile phones, tablets and other consumer electronics devices throughout the United States, and is in the process of developing and distributing end-to-end communication terminals and IoT solutions. For more information, please visit http://foxxusa.com and http://ir.foxxusa.com . About FreeCast FreeCast Inc., founded in 2011 and headquartered in Orlando, Florida, is a leading streaming media platform that simplifies how users discover and enjoy digital entertainment. The company’s flagship solution addresses the challenges of managing multiple streaming services by consolidating hundreds of content providers into a single, intuitive interface. FreeCast’s comprehensive platform gives users access to over 700 free channels, premium on-demand content, and live TV streaming, while making it easy to search and browse content across major streaming services. Through its advanced content aggregation and universal search capabilities, FreeCast helps users find and organize their entertainment choices more efficiently and serves as a practical solution for the modern streamer. For more information, visit www.freecast.com . title: Como aumentar a eficiência operacional? 5 estratégias!
summary: Aprenda a aumentar a eficiência operacional a partir de dicas que incluem tecnologias e estratégias e as vantagens para a sua empresa
body_text: Descobrir como aumentar a eficiência operacional é um dos segredos para a realização de processos e atividades muito mais precisos, dinâmicos, a custos reduzidos e sem comprometer a qualidade dos produtos e/ou serviços que o seu negócio vende aos clientes finais. Afinal, o conceito se refere à capacidade de um negócio de melhorar continuamente, a fim de encontrar rotinas de trabalho que maximizam os recursos financeiros, evitam desperdício de dinheiro e de recursos e que ajudam a aumentar a produtividade dos times . Algumas perguntas que os gestores têm sobre essa prática são: “Em uma empresa já consolidada, é possível melhorar o resultado operacional?”, “Quais os impactos das mudanças na gestão financeira da companhia?” Você também tem dúvidas assim? Então, siga a leitura deste artigo para obter as respostas e conhecer cinco estratégicas para aumentar a eficiência operacional do seu negócio! O que é eficiência operacional? A eficiência operacional é a capacidade de uma organização de alcançar resultados melhores a partir da definição e adoção de estratégias que aprimoram as operações sem aumentar os custos. Um dos objetivos é tornar o negócio mais competitivo e capacitado para expandir de maneira sustentável. Para tornar as operações de uma empresa mais eficientes, é preciso focar na melhoria contínua dos processos internos. Afinal, os mercados mudam constantemente e não se adequar torna a dinâmica de trabalho obsoleta e desalinhada às necessidades e expectativas do público-alvo e demais stakeholders , como investidores e parceiros de negócio. Portanto, para saber como aumentar a eficiência operacional do seu negócio, siga estes passos: identificar gargalos e áreas que geram desperdício financeiro, de materiais e de mão de obra; usar a tecnologia para automatizar processos e realizar análise de dados para embasar decisão; aprimorar a gestão de recursos humanos. Mais adiante, apresentaremos cinco estratégias que ajudam (e muito) a melhorar o resultado operacional de um negócio. Antes, é interessante você saber quais são as vantagens de ter operações eficientes. Listamos as principais no próximo tópico. Confira! Quais os benefícios de aumentar a eficiência operacional? Estes são os principais benefícios de aumentar a eficiência operacional da sua empresa: entrega de produtos/serviços em menos tempo aos consumidores; garantia de qualidade das soluções finais; possibilidade de elevar a lucratividade; redução de custos; diminuição de desperdícios; eliminação, ou ao menos atenuação, da necessidade de retrabalho; fomento à inovação; aumento da satisfação do cliente final; mitigação de riscos; elevação da produtividade individual e coletiva; ganho de poder competitivo; flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a mudanças. Dica de leitura: “ Resiliência empresarial: por quais motivos é importante? ” 5 estratégias para aumentar a eficiência operacional Estas são as cinco melhores estratégias para aumentar a eficiência operacional de um negócio: revisar os processos; adotar as tecnologias certas; embasar as decisões em dados; usar técnicas de melhoria contínua; entregar boas ferramentas de trabalho aos times. Entenda os detalhes. 1. Revisar os processos O primeiro passo de como aumentar a eficiência operacional consiste em olhar para a forma atual de trabalho da sua empresa. Portanto, mapeie os processos para identificar, por exemplo, fluxos ineficientes, gargalos e excesso de burocracia. O objetivo aqui é “enxugar” as atividades, eliminar redundâncias e tornar as tarefas mais fluidas, ágeis, dinâmicas e precisas. 2. Adotar as tecnologias certas Como dar às tarefas essas características? Por meio das tecnologias certas! É preciso adotar softwares e ferramentas para automatizar processos e, assim, diminuir os erros, reduzir o tempo de execução e aumentar a produtividade dos times. Escolha as soluções conforme a atividade que precisa tornar mais eficiente. Por exemplo, se é a gestão de fornecedores, contrate um SRM , Supplier Relationship Management. Um bom software de gestão de relacionamento com fornecedores, como o da Linkana, oferece funcionalidades voltadas para a otimização do processo de homologação e também: gestão por categoria; consultas automáticas portal de fornecedores fluxos de aprovação Confira, no vídeo abaixo, o que o SRM da Linkana oferece. 3. Embasar as decisões em dados Aproveite os relatórios que as ferramentas de automação geram para embasar as suas decisões. Em um processo de gestão de pedidos de compras , por exemplo, você pode usar os dados para verificar volume de estoque e recorrência de aquisição para não comprar itens a mais (e gerar gastos extras) ou a menos (e causar ruptura no estoque). Independentemente do processo, os dados aumentam a eficiência operacional porque eliminam achismo e, por consequência, falhas que levam à necessidade de retrabalho. 4. Usar técnicas de melhoria contínua Somada à tecnologia, adote diferentes técnicas de melhoria contínua, como: método Kaizen : filosofia japonesa que promove aprimoramentos a partir de pequenas mudanças e ajustes; ciclo PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) : consiste em planejar processos, executá-los, checar os resultados e agir com base nos aprendizados extraídos para aprimorá-los; Lean Thinking : metodologia focada na eliminação de desperdício, otimização de processos e acréscimo de valor ao cliente por meio de ajustes constantes nas operações. Dica! Este artigo, certamente, ajudará você: “ Como promover a melhoria contínua na gestão de fornecedores? ”. Não deixe de ler! 5. Entregar boas ferramentas de trabalho aos times Não há como melhorar o resultado operacional da sua empresa sem um time produtivo. Contudo, para ajudá-los nesse ponto, é crucial oferecer boas ferramentas de trabalho, como: aplicativos para facilitar a comunicação, a exemplo do Slack e WhatsApp Business; plataformas de organização de projetos, como o Trello e o Asana; plataformas para armazenamento e compartilhamento de documentos em nuvem, como Google Drive. Também é importante utilizar sistemas integrados, como um SRM conectado a um ERP. Assim, é possível aproveitar informações, facilitar acesso a dados e, por fim, reduzir o tempo de execução das tarefas. Qual o impacto da eficiência operacional na gestão financeira? Aumentar a eficiência operacional causa impacto positivo na gestão financeira. Afinal, processos eficientes ajudam a maximizar o uso dos recursos monetários, evitar desperdícios e eliminar gastos extras. Como resultado, é possível elevar a margem de lucro e a lucratividade, principalmente por melhorar o relacionamento com os clientes finais que receberão produtos/serviços em menos tempo e com a qualidade esperada. Leia também: “ Gestão de gastos corporativos: 5 desafios e como resolvê-los ” Como as empresas aumentam a eficiência operacional? **As empresas aumentam a eficiência operacional a partir da junção de várias estratégias, como as que citamos ao longo deste artigo. A ideia é encontrar meios de otimizar os processos e deixar os times mais produtivos. ** Porém, para bons resultados, é fundamental abranger todas as áreas da companhia, e uma das mais críticas, que merece atenção especial, é a gestão de fornecedores. O motivo, é que o relacionamento com os parceiros de abastecimento influencia toda a dinâmica de funcionamento do negócio, além de gerar vários riscos e ter alto potencial de afetar a gestão financeira. O SRM da Linkana entrega a você a tecnologia necessária para automatizar todas as etapas da homologação de fornecedores, reduzir o tempo de análise, aprovação e, assim, formar uma rede de abastecimento muito mais sólida e eficiente. Agende agora uma demonstração e confira, na prática, tudo o que a Linkana oferece para a sua empresa! FAQ Quais são os benefícios de aumentar a eficiência operacional? Os principais benefícios de aumentar a eficiência operacional são: reduzir custos, diminuir desperdício, elevar a produtividade, garantir a qualidade, entregar as soluções em menos tempo aos clientes finais, manter a empresa competitiva. Como melhorar o resultado operacional? Para melhorar o resultado operacional é preciso revisar os processos para encontrar gargalos e pontos de melhoria, usar a tecnologia para promover a automação, adotar diferentes técnicas para aprimoramento contínuo e entregar aos times boas ferramentas de trabalho.

title: Guest Post: GSDIa Treatment Quest
summary: GSDIa advocates share about the historic support the community has provided for gene therapy research.
body_text: Living with Glycogen Storage Disease Type Ia (GSDIa) is a daily challenge for both individuals and families. This genetic disorder results in the buildup of glycogen (the stored form of glucose) in the body’s cells and an inability to regulate and maintain normal blood sugar levels. At present, no therapeutic treatment options that treat the underlying cause of the disease are available. Patients must rely on a strict dietary protocol of ingesting raw cornstarch to sustain bodily functions and must maintain a specific diet to manage their condition. As shared in a recent guest post titled, “Living life by the clock,” missing a single dose of cornstarch can lead to dangerous episodes of hypoglycemia that can be life-threatening, particularly in children. That leads to constant concern and anxiety about the well-being of the individual throughout the day and especially at night. Michael Julius and Lisa Hodes, dedicated board members of The Children’s Fund for GSD Research, understand intimately the complexities of raising children with GSDIa. They have been instrumental in the community’s quest for new treatments. Below they share their perspectives.

title: You have 5 days before the new DockerHub limits f*ck you over
summary: Docker Hub is slamming the brakes on free usage April 1st. These strict pull limits will silently break your CI if you’re not ready. You could build a registry mirror, audit 500 workflows, or... just switch to Blacksmith. Our runners come preconfigured with a pull-through cache that makes Docker pull limits a non-issue.
body_text: Docker Hub is about to implement much stricter pull rate limits starting April 1st, 2025 . If you're running CI/CD pipelines—especially on self-hosted runners—this could hurt. GitHub-hosted GitHub Actions runners get a pass here because of their IP whitelisting agreements with Docker. This is a rare situation in which running your GitHub Actions on their slower, much more expensive machines has saved you from some pain! If you've been happily enjoying the use of a free DockerHub account and want to continue, you'll want to keep reading... Docker tightening their grip Docker is tightening their pull limits to the extent that everyone who is not on a Pro, Team or a Business plan is on notice: As expected, there was public outcry. Yet, I don't think even Docker expected the level of pushback they got because if you check the previous versions of their announcement , you will see that they quickly reacted to the bad press and pushed back the in-effect date from March 1st to April 1st, and changed various values in this table. Here's a screenshot my cofounder took around the day this was first announced: As much as I enjoy the discourse, this is not a writeup about whether this is fair or not, for that we have HackerNews . What frustrated me most was Docker's short notice before implementing this change. What I am afraid will break The immediate impact will hit CI pipelines across organizations of all sizes. Even a modest test suite running a few containers can quickly exceed the new limit of 10 pulls per hour per IP for unauthenticated requests. A small team of 2-3 engineers pushing multiple commits or running parallel jobs might hit this limit in minutes. Miss just one authentication step in your workflow, and you'll face those dreaded 429 (Too Many Requests) errors, grinding your dev cycles to a halt. Production deployments using unauthenticated Docker Hub access are at risk too. Many production environments—surprisingly—pull public containers without proper authentication. As your CD pipeline pulls images across multiple environments or regions, you can quickly hit rate limits and temporarily break your deployment pipeline. Solutions that are doable in the next week Option 1: Set up your own pull-through cache mirror Option 1 requires you to create your own Docker registry mirror that caches pulls of public images:‍ storage: s3: accesskey: {{ minio_access_key }} secretkey: {{ minio_secret_key }} region: us-east-1 bucket: docker-registry regionendpoint: http://{{ minio_endpoint }}:9000 secure: false v4auth: true chunksize: 5242880 rootdirectory: / cache: blobdescriptor: inmemory maintenance: uploadpurging: enabled: true age: 168h interval: 24h dryrun: false proxy: remoteurl: https://registry-1.docker.io http: addr: " {{ registry_address }} " relativeurls: false draintimeout: 60s secret: " {{ http_secret }} " This will ensure you reduce your hits on the Docker hub registry, but requires a solid 2-3 days of engineering time to set up properly, plus ongoing maintenance to ensure HA and to scale out your storage cluster. You'll need to navigate storage configuration, network setup across all your runners, and probably a month of back-and-forth with that security-obsessed CIO who keeps asking "but why can't you just pay for Docker?!". Option 2: Authenticate with Docker Hub Option 2 requires adding authentication to every workflow, which raises your limit to 100 pulls per hour: jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Login to Docker Hub uses: docker/login-action@v2 with: username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }} password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }} # Your existing steps... However, this solution only partially works since it’s only a 10x increase on your pull limit and more importantly involves significant organizational overhead. While it may seem straightforward at first, consider the scale: a mid-sized company with 40+ engineers typically manages 50+ repositories containing 250+ workflow files. For larger organizations with 200+ engineers, these numbers grow exponentially—potentially reaching 2,000+ workflows spread across hundreds of repositories. title: Understanding Dog Cancer Treatment Options: Surgery, Chemotherapy, Radiation, & Targeted Therapy
summary: Learn about the various treatment options for dog cancer, including surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, and targeted therapy. Understand the benefits, challenges, and advancements in canine oncology to make informed decisions for your dog's care.
body_text: When your dog is diagnosed with cancer, the amount of information can feel overwhelming. As veterinary oncology experts, we want to help you understand the treatment options available to your dog. Cancer treatments for dogs typically include surgery, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and targeted therapy. Your veterinarian will recommend the most appropriate course of treatment based on your dog's specific cancer type and overall health. Surgery is often the first line of defense in treating many canine cancers. The primary goal of surgical intervention is to remove the tumor and surrounding cancerous tissue, potentially preventing the disease from spreading further. Depending on the tumor's location, size, and type, surgery can be a standalone treatment or part of a comprehensive cancer management plan. In some cases, surgical removal can completely eliminate the cancer, while in others, it helps reduce tumor size before additional treatments like chemotherapy or radiation. Chemotherapy is a common treatment that involves using drugs to kill cancer cells or inhibit their growth. While traditional chemotherapy can be challenging because it doesn't differentiate between healthy and cancerous cells, advancements in veterinary medicine have made treatments more refined and less taxing on your dog. Chemotherapy is administered at a veterinary clinic orally, intravenously, or through injections, to slow or stop cancer progression. Radiation therapy is another tool against cancer. Using high-energy rays, veterinarians can target and destroy cancer cells in specific areas of the body. Radiation is typically used against tumors that cannot be fully removed through surgery or as an adjunct to other treatments. However, like chemotherapy, it can also damage some healthy cells. Additionally, because the dog must remain completely still during the procedure, anesthesia is required for each treatment, which carries slight risks. Chemotherapy and Radiation: Challenges and Considerations While chemotherapy and radiation have been standard cancer treatments, veterinary oncology recognizes significant challenges in their application. Despite their potential benefits, these treatments are too harsh for many canine patients–many of which are older dogs. This causes pet owners to discontinue traditional treatments like chemotherapy or radiation before complete cancer elimination due to severe side effects that compromise their dog's quality of life. These treatments can create additional practical challenges, such as special waste handling precautions. For instance, owners are advised to: Wear gloves when handling dog waste Avoid contact with waste for 72 hours after treatment Designate low-traffic areas for the dog's elimination These challenges have driven the development of more advanced approaches like targeted therapy. Targeted therapy , a form of precision medicine, is one of the most personalized approaches to cancer treatment. Targeted therapy uses drugs to target specific molecules that cancer cells need to survive and spread. By identifying specific genetic mutations driving your dog's cancer, we can match them with therapies designed to attack those precise molecular targets. Research published in Nature Precision Oncology has shown that this approach can extend survival times up to three times compared to conventional treatments. These therapies have fewer side effects than other treatments, as they focus on cancer cells while sparing healthy tissue. Unlike chemotherapy and radiation, targeted therapies can be administered orally at home, making them easier and safer for both you and your dog. To find the best treatment, we use AI and the world's largest database of canine cancer genomics. Our proprietary AI engine, Fetch, analyzes over 2 billion data points from 6,000 dogs with naturally occurring cancers to identify the most effective, personalized drug therapies. By matching each dog's tumor mutations with targeted therapies and utilizing breed-specific genetic information, we move beyond traditional "educated guesswork" to provide evidence-based, precision treatment plans. This approach improves treatment outcomes and minimizes unnecessary side effects, offering a more effective and humane approach to canine cancer care. Ultimately, the best treatment plan depends on multiple factors: cancer type, stage, your dog's overall health, and your family's preferences. We understand how difficult a cancer diagnosis can be, but by working closely with your veterinarian and exploring these treatment options, you're giving your dog the best chance at fighting this disease.

title: How to Calculate MER for Ecommerce: A Comprehensive Guide
summary: The AI-Native commerce suite of choice for bold CIOs and CEOs. Modernize your stack and drive operational results with unified commerce solutions for D2C, B2C, B2B, and Marketplaces.
body_text: One of the most reliable metrics for evaluating marketing performance is the marketing efficiency ratio (MER), which helps ecommerce managers understand how effectively their investments translate into revenue. This guide explores MER in depth—its definition, calculation, importance, and practical tools to monitor and improve it. What does MER stand for? MER is an acronym for Marketing Efficiency Ratio. It's a holistic indicator of how well your marketing dollars work for you. In ecommerce, where multi-channel and omnichannel strategies dominate, MER evaluates the combined impact of all campaigns by comparing total revenue to total marketing spend. How to calculate MER for ecommerce? Now, let’s take a closer look at how you can calculate MER. What is the formula for MER? The formula is: MER = Total Revenue ÷ Total Marketing Spend For example, if your ecommerce store generated USD 100,000 in total revenue and your total marketing spend across all channels was USD 20,000, here’s how you’d calculate: MER = USD 100,000 ÷ USD 20,000 = USD 5 This means that for every dollar spent on marketing, you generated USD 5 in revenue. How to calculate MER in marketing? To calculate MER in marketing, you need to total your spending across all marketing channels, including: Paid advertisements (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads) Email marketing campaigns Influencer collaborations Affiliate marketing programs For example, if you spent USD 10,000 on paid ads, USD 3,000 on email marketing, and USD 2,000 on influencer partnerships, your total marketing spend would be USD 15,000. If your ecommerce store generated USD 75,000 in revenue, your MER would be: MER = USD 75,000 ÷ USD 15,000 = USD 5 What does MER mean in ecommerce? MER gives a holistic snapshot of how efficiently marketing dollars drive sales. A strong MER indicates a sustainable balance between investment and revenue, helping brands optimize spend across channels. By tracking MER over time, ecommerce businesses can assess profitability, adjust strategies, and ensure long-term growth. A poor MER—where marketing spend outweighs revenue—signals inefficiency in ad investments and potential profitability issues. It could indicate overspending on underperforming channels, rising acquisition costs, or weak conversion rates. A declining MER over time might suggest diminishing returns on marketing efforts, requiring a reassessment of budget allocation, audience targeting, or overall ecommerce strategy. If left unchecked, a poor MER can strain margins and hinder long-term growth. Why MER matters for ecommerce success? MER is a strategic tool for aligning your marketing investments with business objectives. Here’s why it’s so critical for success: Holistic View of Performance: Unlike channel-specific metrics, MER captures the bigger picture of marketing effectiveness Budget Allocation Insights: You can identify where to double down and where to cut back by analyzing MER trends Profitability Monitoring: MER helps ensure your marketing spend is directly contributing to your bottom line Tools and techniques for monitoring MER Tracking MER is all about having the right tools and strategies in place to ensure accurate and actionable insights. Monitoring Tools Google Analytics: Combines traffic, revenue, and spending data to simplify MER tracking Ecommerce Platforms: Platforms like VTEX provide comprehensive revenue and spend reports tailored for ecommerce needs, combining sales and marketing data Marketing Automation Software: Tools like HubSpot and Klaviyo streamline campaign cost tracking Techniques for tracking trends Custom Dashboards: Build dashboards to visualize MER trends over time Integrated Reporting: Use tools that centralize data across marketing channels Real-Time Analysis: Monitor performance in real-time to react quickly to inefficiencies VTEX elevates these trend tracking techniques by integrating them directly into its platform. Custom dashboards on VTEX bring your MER trends to life, offering a clear view of performance over time. Integrated reporting pulls together data from every marketing channel, creating a single, unified source of truth. And real-time analysis lets you spot and fix inefficiencies as they occur. With VTEX, you’re turning data into actionable insights that keep your ecommerce operation agile and ahead of market shifts. FAQs About How to Calculate MER for Ecommerce Curious about the finer details of MER? This section addresses common questions about calculating and interpreting MER for ecommerce. What is the formula for MER? Marketing efficiency ratio (MER) = Total Revenue ÷ Total Marketing Spend. How to calculate MER in marketing? Aggregate total marketing spending across all channels and divide it by total revenue to calculate your marketing efficiency ratio (MER). What does MER mean in ecommerce?
